headlines.title: 재경부, 아시아 11개국 고위공무원 초청연수 … 경제·금융협력 강화
headlines.summary: 9~13일 재무부·중앙은행 관계자 참여 한국 경제성장 경험·금융정책 공유 재정경제부 2026.1.2 ⓒ 뉴스1 김기남 기자 (세종=뉴스1) 이강 기자 = 재정경제부가 아시아 11개국 재무부·중앙은행 고위공무원을 초청해 한국의 경제성장 경험과 금융정책을 공유하고 경제·금융협력 기반을 강화한다.

headlines.title: 서울 빌라도 전셋값 급등 … 동대문 1년새 25% 상승
headlines.summary: 평당 보증금 2209만원, 7.2% 상승 동대문구 40㎡ 환산 땐 6290만원 ↑ 아파트 매물부족에 빌라 전세로 몰려 서울 아파트 전세난이 이어지는 가운데, 상대적으로 가격 부담이 적은 연립·다세대주택에서도 수급 불균형이 나타나며 전세보증금이 가파르게 오르고 있다. 동대문구는 1년 새 신규 전세보증금이 25% 넘게 뛰었다.

key_headlines.title: South Korea's Q3 Growth Rate Reaches 3.4% on AI and Semiconductor Boom

key_headlines.title: Current Account Surplus Expands as Semiconductor Exports Surge
key_headlines.summary: South Korea's current account remains in surplus for June with expanded merchandise trade surplus driven by strong semiconductor exports, signaling robust export performance.

key_headlines.title: Nuclear Power Policy Fragmentation Threatens Korea's Energy Strategy
key_headlines.summary: Concerns mount over lack of unified policy control tower as nuclear development functions are dispersed across multiple government ministries, affecting both domestic and export projects.

key_headlines.title: National Assembly Begins Review of 820.9 Trillion Won Budget for Next Year
key_headlines.summary: South Korea's parliament launches comprehensive review of next year's budget, which is 12.8% larger than current year, with disputes expected over future response fund allocation.

key_headlines.title: South Korea Hosts Asian Economic Officials for Finance Cooperation Initiatives
key_headlines.summary: Ministry of Economy and Finance invites senior officials from 11 Asian countries to share Korea's economic growth experience and strengthen regional financial cooperation.

sections.Hot Economy News: South Korea's economy is experiencing a dual-track growth pattern, with AI infrastructure investment and semiconductor exports driving robust expansion at 3.4% in Q3. However, the benefits are not evenly distributed, as domestic consumption growth has decelerated significantly from 2.4% to 1.1%, indicating that semiconductor sector gains have not yet translated into household income improvements. The country's current account surplus is expanding thanks to strong export performance, particularly in semiconductors, though high oil prices and elevated interest rates continue to burden household finances. Key macroeconomic indicators show facility investment rising 10.1%, but concerns persist over Middle East geopolitical tensions and volatile international oil prices affecting economic outlook.
sections.Macro & Fiscal Policy: Korea Development Institute's November report emphasizes that while AI-led investment maintains positive growth momentum, the ripple effects to consumers remain sluggish. China's producer prices surged 5.7% in October, marking a four-year high amid global energy inflation, though domestic consumption remains weak. The U.S. labor market surprised on the upside with 165,000 job additions in October and unemployment falling to 4.1%, strengthening arguments for potential additional Federal Reserve rate hikes in December. South Korea's parliament has begun reviewing a budget of 820.9 trillion won for next year, representing 12.8% growth from the current year, with expectations of contentious debates over future response fund allocation. Global economic uncertainty persists from U.S. midterm election results and ongoing geopolitical tensions affecting commodity prices.
sections.Financial Markets: Chinese technology stocks demonstrated surprising resilience, gaining 8% even as the Kospi fell 11%, supported by Beijing's expanded equity market support measures including swap facility expansions and lower share buyback lending rates. Samsung Asset Management launched a new monthly dividend ETF combining 50% allocation to U.S. short-term treasury bills with 50% exposure to Nasdaq 100, targeting investors seeking stability alongside growth through AI and semiconductor innovation firms. The Kospi opened 0.50% lower at 5034.20, struggling to gain traction despite overnight U.S. market recovery, with most sectors declining including transportation equipment and metals. Foreign investors are net sellers at 401.3 billion won while individuals are net buyers, suggesting divergent sentiment in the market. U.S. equity markets rebounded overnight on AI semiconductor buying opportunities, though upward momentum remained constrained by persistent interest rate concerns.
sections.Industry & Technology: Middle East energy inflation is emerging as a tailwind for Korean electric vehicle exports to Europe, as elevated energy prices increase demand for fuel-efficient vehicles. FineMetals aims to establish energy storage systems and automotive electronics as new growth pillars, targeting 150 billion won in combined sales by 2027 through precision manufacturing in North American markets. HK, a laser processing equipment specialist, has achieved a breakthrough by entering domestic automakers' Tier-1 supply chains for the first time, securing orders for next-generation vehicle panel automation lines. AI Korea has expanded into Yongin's semiconductor cluster with cooling and energy management systems for battery production facilities across major Korean and international manufacturers. Precision equipment manufacturers are positioning themselves to capitalize on growing AI data center infrastructure demands alongside traditional semiconductor and automotive sectors.
sections.Real Estate: Seoul's villa and multi-unit housing monthly rental market is facing its lowest supply on record for Q1 next year, with less than 20,000 units available due to effects from jeonse fraud scandals and sluggish new supply amid rising prices burdening lower-income renters. A new shared ownership housing model debuted in Gwanggyeong New City's second phase, where buyers need only pay 25% of the list price initially, offering creative solutions to affordability challenges. Younger populations aged 30-40 are driving new apartment sales in provincial new cities, according to Korea Real Estate Board data, with 135 private-sector housing complexes supplied in regional areas over the past year. IPARK Hyundai Industrial Development secured construction rights for Goyang Neungok District 3 redevelopment project valued at 517.4 billion won with 89.1% approval from residents. Mixed signals persist in the real estate sector as supply constraints conflict with affordability concerns in major metropolitan areas.
sections.International Economy: Democrats, having regained control of Congress in midterm elections, are moving to dismantle Trump administration tariff policies, targeting Canadian goods first and seeking to restore congressional authority over tariff decisions. China extended its 24% additional tariff suspension on U.S. imports by two months, citing implementation of agreements from recent summit discussions and signaling restrained trade escalation despite ongoing bilateral tensions. The Federal Reserve faces mounting pressure for additional rate increases as strong employment data, with jobless rates at 4.1% and wage growth of 0.4% month-over-month, contradict the central bank's recent pause. Conflicting policy signals from major economies create uncertainty: while the U.S. considers tighter monetary conditions, China maintains measured stimulus approaches focused on export strength rather than aggressive domestic demand measures. Trump publicly defended Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang despite admitted misconduct allegations, indicating corporate and geopolitical considerations shaping U.S.-China technology relations.
sections.AI & Economy: Korea Development Institute upgraded economic assessment language from September's 'maintaining improvement trend' to November's 'sound growth,' reflecting strengthening AI-infrastructure-led investment momentum and semiconductor production gains. SnetSystems is leveraging renewable energy plant project experience to expand into the AI data center market, partnering with global automation leader Emerson to develop integrated infrastructure spanning energy and data center operations. Credit Guarantee Fund is integrating artificial intelligence across policy finance services to better support SME and mid-market companies, hosting an AI innovation conference with 120+ employees and exploring venture capital market activation and intangible asset-based financing. Law firm Pacific is organizing an AI regulatory seminar addressing recent policy challenges including the AI Basic Law implementation and emerging agentic AI and physical AI concerns. RFHIC, specializing in gallium nitride semiconductors for communications, expects significant benefits from accelerating AI data center and 5G infrastructure investments globally.
sections.Others: BridgeOver was registered as Korea distributor for ServerLIFT's data center-specific automated equipment lifts, providing localized pricing, customs clearance, operational training and maintenance support. Korea Radio Promotion Association is recruiting 28 trainees for its 6th Cisco Security Academy program funded by the Ministry of Employment and Labor's K-Digital Training initiative, running from December 2026 through June 2027. South Korea's security establishment reaffirmed commitment to wartime operational control handover agreement despite concerns that U.S. midterm election results could jeopardize security cooperation arrangements with the Trump administration. Alteogen reports that Keytruda SC maintains growth momentum despite U.S. drug pricing pressures, with Hybrido continue facing competitive challenges in the evolving pharmaceutical landscape. E8, an ontology AI and digital twin specialist, secured six government research contracts in 2026, achieving record performance and now managing ten total national R&D projects across building energy management simulation and automotive manufacturing process optimization.
